lines.t: (Wordless vocal ad-libs over ambient pads and low choir)
Ohh… ohh…
Only Your glory…
Eyes like fire, breaking through the midnight sky
Thunder on the waters, every distant star replies
Robes of blinding whiteness, wrapped in uncreated light
Nations start to tremble at the drawing of Your sight
Mountains fall like sand under the weight of Your Name
Heaven’s floor is shaking, every angel in flames
Mercy in Your whisper, but a sword in Your breath
Glory in Your rising, holy terror in Your steps
This is the King in dreadful splendor
Clothed in the storm, in burning thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces, under
The weight of Your glory, the weight of Your glory
Radiant terror, consuming fire
Love like an ocean, wrath like a choir
Lifting Your power, higher and higher
The weight of Your glory, the weight of Your glory
Only Your glory… only Your glory…
Every crown falling down before Your story
Only Your glory… only Your glory…
Smoke fills the temple, thresholds shake with living sound
Seraphim are crying as the pillars all fall down
Train of Your robe flooding worlds yet to be named
Dust becomes a mirror, catching echoes of Your flame
Woe to the proud when Your holiness appears
Every secret spoken, every hidden, naked fear
Coal upon the lips, ashes spilling from our hands
Undone by the gaze of the One before we stand
This is the King in dreadful splendor
Clothed in the storm, in burning thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces, under
The weight of Your glory, the weight of Your glory
Radiant terror, consuming fire
Love like an ocean, wrath like a choir
Lifting Your power, higher and higher
The weight of Your glory, the weight of Your glory
Glory… glory…
Terror… fire…
You come in power, the final hour
Glory… glory…
Terror… fire…
You come in power, the final hour
[BRIDGE 1]
“Undone… I am undone…” in the halls of Your throne
One word from Your mouth and the ruins are a home
Smoke and sapphire, thunder and glass
Worlds fall silent as the ages pass
Galaxies spin on the edge of Your hand
Worlds fall quiet when You rise to stand
Voices of a million suns break in Your roar
Every knee crashing down on the floor
[INSTRUMENTAL / DROP 2]
(Wordless chant over deep bass and choir)
Ohh… ohh…
Only Your glory…
Ohh… ohh…
Only Your glory…
Holy fear in the heart of creation
Every breath is a silent confession
All we built falls away in a moment
Only Your glory, only Your glory
This is the King in dreadful splendor
Clothed in the storm, in burning thunder
Heaven and earth on their faces, under
The weight of Your glory, the weight of Your glory
When You appear, no shadow will remain
Beauty and terror in a single Name
Love that can shatter, love that can save
Fall to our faces now, while it’s still today
